description: This file defines the interface 'NodeGrantDatabaseStorageInterface' for managing node access grants in Drupal, including methods for checking grants, altering queries, writing grants, deleting records, and access control.

classes.name: NodeGrantDatabaseStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for node access grant storage operations in Drupal.

methods.name: checkAll
methods.description: Checks all grants for a given user account.

methods.name: alterQuery
methods.description: Alters a query when node access is required based on operation and user.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a list of grants to the database, optionally deleting previous grants.

methods.name: writeDefault
methods.description: Creates the default node access grant entry.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Determines access to nodes based on grants for a user and operation.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the total number of node grants.

methods.name: deleteNodeRecords
methods.description: Removes access records for specified node IDs.
